I love everything about the app, but the credit card tracking logic has a major flaw if your bill doesnt align with a calendar month. My cycle runs June 4-July 3, due July 24. I set the billing date to the 3rd and due date to the 24th. However, the app forces a strict calendar month view. When I log a purchase on july 4, the app says its due on july 24. It doesnt understand that this expense belongs to the next cycle and isnt due until august 24. Please fix this 🙏
